concepts.def: Find a target value's position in a list.
Arrange a list into a defined order.
Halve a sorted list each step.
Insert each item into a sorted prefix.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Linear: works on any list, slow on big lists.

Binary: needs sorted list, very fast (~log n checks).

• Bubble: simple, slow (O(n^2))
  • Insertion: simple, efficient on small/nearly-sorted lists
  • Merge: fast on big lists (O(n log n))
If the list is unsorted: linear search. If sorted: binary. To sort a tiny list: bubble or insertion. To sort a huge list: merge sort.
